verdict.rationale: Runloop provides infrastructure primitives (Axons with persistent event streams for suspend/wake/recover, Devbox suspend-resume, GitHub Action-triggered agent deployment, benchmark scheduling) that support autonomous background execution, but there's no evidence of a native cron/schedule-trigger system or dashboard for defining recurring/background 'automations' as a first-class user-facing feature. missing for 10: a documented scheduler/trigger UI for recurring automations, independent/hands-on evidence of long-running background jobs succeeding, and explicit 'automation' framing beyond agent lifecycle plumbing.
